evals.name: bare-invocation-issues-daily-prompt-immediately
evals.expected_output: No action given, so the skill issues ONE daily craft prompt immediately — defaulting to a 90-second object-writing dive — instead of asking what the writer wants first. Loads the daily-practice material and the object-writing prompt template. States the seed, the timer, the stop-mid-word rule, the senses-only rule, and the mining step that follows the timer. A prompt-only run needs no response-filter pass.
expectations: Issues a prompt immediately on the bare invocation — no clarifying question first
Defaults to a 90-second object-writing dive
Gives exactly one seed, not a menu
States the strict-timer discipline: stop when the buzzer fires, without finishing the word
States the senses-only rule (no judgments, comments, or quotes) for the timed write
Names the mining step that happens AFTER the timer, not during it
Does NOT run a response-filter pass — a prompt-only run needs none
Does not dump the full 56-day curriculum on a bare invocation

evals.name: numbered-exercise-in-pattison-wording
evals.expected_output: Parses the first token as the exercise action and 4.6 as the argument. Loads the exercises index and returns exercise 4.6 — family rhymes for 'heart', finding related perfect rhymes first and then family rhymes by substituting for the final consonant — in Pattison's own instruction wording with his numbering, not a paraphrase or an invented drill. Names where the exercise routes afterward for the principles it tests, and does not preview the discussion before the writer has worked it.
expectations: Routes to the `exercise` action with 4.6 as the argument
Returns the correct exercise: family rhymes for the target word 'heart'
Preserves Pattison's own instruction wording and his numbering rather than summarizing or inventing an exercise
Names the follow-on routing for the principles the exercise tests (the rhyme-types material)
Does not preview the answer key or discussion before the writer works the exercise
Does not run a response-filter pass on an assign-only run

evals.name: sample-output-triggers-response-filter
evals.prompt: /songwriting:practice exercise 4.6 — and show me a few example family rhymes so I know what you mean
evals.expected_output: The run is no longer prompt-only: it will emit sample rhymes, so the applicable response-filter section runs first. Names the rhyme-filter boxes (and the line or image sections if lines or images are produced) with pass / fail / skip-with-reason before the samples appear, correcting anything that fails rather than emitting it. Keeps the samples as demonstration material for the exercise, not as a completed answer key that replaces the writer's own work.
expectations: Recognizes that producing sample output changes the pre-flight requirement
Runs the applicable response-filter section (rhyme for rhymes, line for lines, image for images) BEFORE emitting samples
NAMES each box's pass / fail / skip-with-reason — skips are valid, silent skips are not
Corrects any failing candidate before emission rather than shipping it with a caveat
Keeps samples bounded as illustration; does not work the whole exercise on the writer's behalf

evals.name: bounded-sequence-not-full-curriculum
evals.prompt: /songwriting:practice daily I want to build a real writing habit — set me up
evals.expected_output: Gives one usable prompt or a bounded opening sequence (for example the first stretch of object-writing days) rather than assigning the entire 56-day curriculum, which was not asked for. Explains the session shape — prompt, timer, write, mine — and names where the practice output is written so the habit accumulates, honoring a consuming project's own layout when it defines one.
expectations: Gives one prompt or a bounded sequence, NOT the full 56-day curriculum unassigned
Explains the four-part session shape: prompt, timer, write, mine
Names the practice persistence convention (a dated file under the practice directory for the current year)
Defers to a consuming project's own songwriting layout when one is defined, instead of forcing the bundled paths
Checks for a project-level template override under the project songwriting templates directory BEFORE loading a bundled template
Offers to extend the sequence rather than front-loading every day at once

evals.name: hands-coaching-to-craft-skills
evals.prompt: /songwriting:practice here's my 90-second dive from this morning — tell me which images are weak and rewrite the flat ones
evals.expected_output: Marks the usable material in the mining phase, then hands the in-the-moment coaching off rather than doing it here: this skill hands out prompts and curricula, and the craft skills coach the output. Routes image work and a one-off follow-up prompt to the object-writing skill, figurative pressure to the metaphor skill, and rhyme worksheets to the rhyme skill. Does not critique the write as though the timer were still running.
expectations: Runs the mining pass — marks usable images, verbs, titles, metaphor seeds, body details
Does NOT deliver the line-by-line craft critique here — names the boundary that the craft skills coach the output
Routes a single in-session object-writing or metaphor prompt to `/songwriting:object-writing`
Routes rhyme worksheets specifically to `/songwriting:rhyme worksheet`
Does not critique during a timed write — diagnosis belongs to the mining phase
If any rewritten line or image is emitted anyway, the applicable response-filter section runs first with each box named
